name: Case study: piston rings, hypothetical limits 74 ± 0.02 mm

reference.note: Hypothetical tighter limits (Cp ≈ 0.68), where Optimise moves the mean towards the reworkable undersize side. Inside diameter of forged piston rings (qcc pistonrings, Montgomery 1991), mm. σ = 0.00986 is the pooled within-sample sd of samples 1–25; the Mean Setting 74.0012 is their mean, the current process. Costs, the Rework Side (undersize bore re-machined) and the rework model are hypothetical. See case_studies/piston_rings.
